divine name in dative of address

items.question: Which sacred mantra formula is proclaimed as addressed to Lord Rudra?
premises: The seed syllable om is stated first.
A salutation is directed to the blessed Lord Rudra.
The formula is explicitly declared as proclaimed.
items.inference: The proclaimed mantra is the formula beginning with om and offering salutation to Rudra.
items.plain_english: The mantra is proclaimed thus: 'Om, salutation to the blessed Lord Rudra.'
